bug_semantics: Authenticated POST /admin/settings/webhooks/create stores an attacker-controlled end_point (WebhookRequest only required|string|max:255). When a workflow fires, WebhookService::triggerWebhook() issues GuzzleHttp\Client::request($method, $data['end_point'], $options) with no scheme/host/IP allowlist, so the CRM server fetches loopback, RFC1918, and link-local/cloud-metadata URLs (e.g. http://127.0.0.1/, http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/). At v2.2.0 (and through v2.2.4) the Guzzle client has no isSafeEndpoint guard and no redirect blocklist (CWE-918 SSRF).
flaw_origin: dec043c2d10241d2ea5051019595e9633b251b51 (suraj kashyap, 2024-07-30, 'integrate webhook to workflow.') first added packages/Webkul/Automation/src/Services/WebhookService.php with new Client() and $this->client->request($data['method'], $data['end_point'], $options). Immediate parent 245c4b1b has no WebhookService.php. 9bebb377 earlier added webhook CRUD and end_point as an unvalidated string, but that commit only persisted the URL; the SSRF sink is the first Guzzle request of that field. Later 91bb7080 added timeouts/query-param append and still requested end_point unguarded. Runtime SSRF guard isSafeEndpoint() plus redirect on_redirect first appears in 7f6b82de (v2.2.5); eec6ac78 then added matching input validation. Advisory first_patched_version is null and GHSA range is <=2.2.0; the sink remained open through v2.2.4.

reasoning: Vulnerability first: published SSRF is real. Authenticated webhook create stores an arbitrary URL; workflow trigger causes the server to Guzzle-request it, including internal/metadata hosts. Not withdrawn. BIC is the smallest commit that first wrote those request lines: dec043c2 added WebhookService.php with client->request(..., $data['end_point'], ...); the parent tree lacks the file entirely, so this is a first-write not a move. 9bebb377 is the earlier unvalidated storage of end_point but has no outbound request sink. dec043c2 is a single-parent non-merge. AI second: judge only the BIC object — human Webkul author/committer, GPG signature, no AI trailer or bot identity — therefore NOT_AI. Claude co-authorship on later eec6ac78 is AI-only-on-fix and does not attribute the BIC. Fix: advisory listed no patched version; public history first closes the Guzzle sink in 7f6b82de (runtime isSafeEndpoint + redirect guard), first tagged v2.2.5. v2.2.0 through v2.2.4 remain unguarded.
